title: Archive copy and document survival plan
summary: Keeps identity, property, medical, repair, seed, and decision records usable when devices fail.
content: Archive copy and document survival plan is a practical offline routine for records preservation. List critical records: identity, property, medical, medicines, contacts, maps, tools, seeds, debts, and community decisions. Create paper copies for records needed during power or internet failure. Store one set near the go-bag and one trusted duplicate away from the same fire/flood risk. Index documents by title, owner, date, and location. Protect private records from public boards and gossip.
steps: Index documents by title, owner, date, and location.
